style_rules: Both attendance slots use mobile-first strict-data V9 production prompts.
Priority order: exact data > report-scope isolation > phone readability > visual polish > layout rigidity.
Create exactly one portrait Vietnamese HR/business infographic using direct ChatGPT Image output.
Preferred portrait aspect is 2:3 to 9:16 for Microsoft Teams phone viewing; use large readable typography and avoid tiny dense dashboard text.
Slight layout variation is allowed when it improves readability or data fidelity.
Use fresh bright green, white/light neutrals, deep navy/professional blue, restrained gold, and red/orange only for missing or attention states.
No logo, no company-name mark, no tagline, no slogan, no motivational quote, no invented decorative text.
Morning scope must never include the full-day report; full-day scope must never include the morning-only report; never generate a second report/page.
Do not calculate, infer, correct, round, reinterpret or fabricate attendance data inside the image.
Missing values display exactly as an em dash.
Show all 8 employees exactly once, in source order, with canonical Vietnamese spelling.
Morning detail fields: STT | Họ và tên | Trạng thái | Giờ vào | Giờ ra | Thời lượng | Mức công.
Full-day detail fields: STT | Họ và tên | Ca sáng | Ca chiều | Tổng công | Trạng thái.
After generation, QA report type, date, update time, KPIs, total/average time, all 8 employees and every displayed row value.
If QA fails, discard and regenerate with ChatGPT Image; never patch, overlay, crop, composite or re-render the failed image.
